# LinkedIn Extension

> Chrome extension for collecting and evaluating LinkedIn search leads.

LinkedIn Extension helps users gather and evaluate lead data from LinkedIn search results. Built with Vitest for unit testing and Playwright for integration testing.

## Key Features
- Collect lead data from LinkedIn search pages
- Evaluate and filter leads based on criteria
- Export collected lead data
- Full test suite (unit + integration)
